newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nansei Sekiyu restarts 100,000 bpd topper.
newsitem.headline: Nansei Sekiyu restarts 100,000 bpd topper.

text.p: Nansei Sekiyu KK said on Wednesday it has restarted a 100,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Nishihara plant on Japan's southern island of Okinawa.
Operations at the plant had been halted since May 12 for regular maintenance work.

The refiner has put its secondary units at the plant, including a 12,000 bpd catalytic reformer, 22,400 bpd naphtha desulphuriser and 15,000 bpd kerosene desulphuriser, back on line along with the CDU, a company spokesman said.
